brand.title: ESourceAIG (Production)
brand.subtitle: Knowledge Check — Your Business Brain Powered by Gemini Notebook

questions.question: According to the course, what are the four main steps in Gemini Notebook's end-to-end workflow?
choices: Upload, Ask, Answers, Export
Organize, Search, Analyze, Present
Input, Query, Process, Download
Collect, Review, Summarize, Share
questions.feedback_correct: Exactly right—Upload, Ask, Answers, Export is the core workflow that transforms raw information into actionable insights.
questions.feedback_incorrect: While these are all reasonable business steps, the course specifically outlines Upload, Ask, Answers, and Export as Gemini Notebook's four-step process on Slide 8.

questions.question: What types of content can be consolidated in Gemini Notebook's single hub?
choices: Only PDF documents and spreadsheets
Meeting Transcripts, Customer Feedback, Market Research, and Financial Docs
Customer feedback and sales reports only
Audio files and website content exclusively
questions.feedback_correct: Perfect—Slide 3 clearly identifies these four content types as examples of what can be consolidated in one hub.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Gemini Notebook is much more versatile than a single document type. Slide 3 shows it consolidates Meeting Transcripts, Customer Feedback, Market Research, and Financial Docs as core content types.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a capability of Gemini Notebook's Studio Panel?
choices: Mind Map visualization
Slide Deck generation
Audio Overview creation
Real-time video conferencing
questions.feedback_correct: Correct—while Gemini Notebook offers Mind Map, Slide Deck, and Audio Overview, video conferencing is not mentioned as a Studio Panel capability.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Slide 7 describes the Studio Panel's three main capabilities: Mind Map, Slide Deck, and Audio Overview. Real-time video conferencing is not among them.

questions.question: What specific business problem does the Sentiment Analysis feature in Slide 4 help solve?
choices: It schedules customer meetings automatically
It identifies what customers love, fear, and want through emotional analysis
It generates automated customer service responses
It tracks inventory levels across warehouses
questions.feedback_correct: Great—Sentiment Analysis reveals the emotional drivers behind customer behavior by identifying what they genuinely love, fear, and seek.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Slide 4 specifically describes Sentiment Analysis as a tool for understanding what customers love, fear, and want. This goes deeper than operational tasks like scheduling or inventory tracking.

questions.question: According to the course, how much time per week can entrepreneurs potentially reclaim by using Gemini Notebook?
choices: 1-2 hours
15-20 hours
5-10 hours
20-30 hours
questions.feedback_correct: Exactly—Slide 9 states that entrepreneurs can reclaim 5-10 hours every week through centralized knowledge and instant answers.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Slide 9 specifically quantifies the time savings as 5-10 hours per week. This is the concrete benefit that helps entrepreneurs focus on higher-value work.

questions.question: What is the recommended starting strategy when implementing Gemini Notebook according to Slide 10?
choices: Upload your entire company's documents at once to maximize efficiency
Pick one pain point and start, letting results guide your expansion
Begin with complex financial analysis before moving to simpler tasks
Implement all features simultaneously across your entire organization
questions.feedback_correct: Perfect—Slide 10 explicitly recommends choosing one pain point and starting small, allowing results to speak for themselves.
questions.feedback_incorrect: While thoroughness is important, Slide 10 emphasizes a "start small" approach focused on one specific pain point. This allows you to see results quickly and build momentum before expanding.

questions.question: How does Gemini Notebook transform the employee onboarding process according to Slide 5?
choices: It replaces human managers with automated systems
It provides new hires with a private, always-available expert grounded in company documents
It eliminates the need for training entirely
It requires all new hires to memorize company policies
questions.feedback_correct: Correct—Slide 5 describes how Gemini Notebook gives new hires access to a personal expert available 24/7, trained on actual company documents.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Slide 5 positions Gemini Notebook as an enhancement to onboarding, not a replacement for people. It creates a searchable knowledge base that acts like a private expert for new hires, available whenever they have questions.

questions.question: Which sales intelligence capability mentioned in Slide 4 helps teams replicate their most successful conversations?
choices: Trend Spotting for complaint analysis
Sales Call Patterns that identify winning words and phrases
Customer sentiment analysis across all feedback
Competitor pricing analysis
questions.feedback_correct: Exactly—Slide 4 emphasizes Sales Call Patterns as the feature that identifies specific words and phrases that consistently move deals forward, allowing teams to replicate success.
questions.feedback_incorrect: While Trend Spotting and Sentiment Analysis are valuable, Slide 4 specifically identifies Sales Call Patterns as the feature that captures winning words and phrases so teams can replicate their most successful conversations.

questions.question: Based on the course content, what is the fundamental difference between Gemini Notebook and simply storing documents in traditional cloud storage?
choices: Gemini Notebook costs less than cloud storage services
Gemini Notebook only works with certain file types while cloud storage accepts everything
Gemini Notebook turns stored documents into actively queryable, summarizable assets that work together to inform decision-making
Gemini Notebook requires no internet connection while cloud storage needs connectivity
questions.feedback_correct: Perfect—the course emphasizes throughout that Gemini Notebook's power isn't just storage; it's about putting information to work through AI-powered intelligence and cross-document analysis.
questions.feedback_incorrect: The distinction goes beyond basic file storage. Slide 1 emphasizes that the real power comes from putting all information to work, not just storing it. Gemini Notebook transforms documents into active tools for thinking and decision-making.

questions.question: Considering the use cases presented throughout the course, which scenario best demonstrates the synthesis of Gemini Notebook's core capabilities?
choices: A company uploads historical meeting transcripts but never uses them
An entrepreneur uploads customer surveys, uses Sentiment Analysis to identify pain points, exports a summary, and then creates a product strategy Mind Map—all in one afternoon
A team stores financial documents without asking any questions about them
A manager reads customer feedback manually instead of using Gemini Notebook's search features
questions.feedback_correct: Excellent—this scenario combines uploading (Slide 10), analysis (Slide 4), export (Slide 8), and the Studio Panel (Slide 7), demonstrating how Gemini Notebook turns raw data into strategic business assets.
questions.feedback_incorrect: This scenario best demonstrates the full value chain: starting with a specific problem, uploading documents, analyzing them intelligently, and exporting polished outputs. The course consistently emphasizes this end-to-end transformation from raw information to actionable strategy.
